max_input_bytes.description:
Largest accepted input, in bytes: the exported text for a WhatsApp export, the whole JSON document for the
other imports. Absent: 33554432 (32 MiB).

max_json_depth.description:
Deepest accepted nesting of JSON arrays and objects in the document handed to msgkit. Through the JSON
entry point that document is the whole request, so its wrapper object counts. Absent: 32.

max_line_bytes.description: Longest accepted line of a WhatsApp export, in bytes. Absent: 262144 (256 KiB).

max_messages.description: Most messages, calls and notices accepted in one import. Absent: 1000000.

unlimited.description: Switches every limit off. The only way to do so; use it only for input you trust. Default `false`.

The exporting user's name as it appears in the chat. Used to decide

time_zone.description:
IANA time-zone name of the phone (exact spelling, e.g. `"Asia/Colombo"`). When set it replaces
`utc_offset_minutes` and follows the zone's daylight-saving rules; event ids do not depend on it. A
time in a repeated hour uses the first occurrence and a time in a skipped hour moves forward by the gap
(reported in one warning). The zone database is bundled with msgkit, so results are the same everywhere.

utc_offset_minutes.description:
Offset of the phone's local time zone from UTC, in minutes
(e.g. `330` for UTC+05:30). Exports carry no time zone. Defaults to `0`. Ignored when `time_zone` is set.
